ns2:course.label: Introduction to Advocacy
ns2:course.description: (LAW 312) Continuation of LAW 609. Introduction to Advocacy is required in the second semester of the first year for further development of legal research skills persuasive writing and oral advocacy. Each student will work on the preparation of a summary judgment motion and an appellate brief relating to their first semester assignment, then argue their assigned case before a panel of local attorneys and faculty. 3 professional hours. 2 graduate hours. Approved for S/U grading only.
